messages:
maya: Heads up — EmberTech just signaled a ramp. CS notes three new internal teams (Creative, Localization, Insights) planning to start next month. They estimate a sustained +3M tokens/day at peak and many small chat requests. Renewal touchpoint is also coming up, so this looks like an expansion + renewal opportunity.
sam: Timeline? any specifics on seq lengths or runtimes?
maya: Targeting mid-April for first squad. Most traffic is short (avg ~80 tokens) but there will be periodic long transcripts (~600-800 tokens) from Insights.
leo: @maya can you share a sample token profile or typical payload sizes when you have a sec?
maya: Pasted rough profile below: avg_seq=80, p95_seq=320, occasional long=800. Mostly chat+few embedding calls for localization similarity.
annie: Renewal call next month — recommend we propose a pilot for Dedicated + enablement workshops. Could be a good upsell into a renewal expansion.
sam: I can draft a pilot plan. Initial rec: 2 dedicated pods with a burst policy and enablement for creative team. Quick autoscale suggestion: 
```
pods: 2
burst_capacity: 1
autoscale: enabled
batching: adaptive
````
opsbot: capacity_ticket created: CT-5819 — tagging eng-runtime and sales for follow-up
leo: For cost tradeoffs, use a quantized 8-bit model variant for Creative (short sequences) and keep full-precision for Insights. Expected savings ~25-35% on token compute.
maya: They also asked about SSO and KMS for Private — security lead wants options before committing.
sam: I'll schedule a sync with their infra lead. @maya please add their infra contact to the thread when you can.
maya: Added EmberInfra (external) to the invite; call set for Wed 10am PT.
annie: I'll prepare renewal talk track + two enablement workshop outlines (developer onboarding + prompt-engineering 101).
sam: Plan ETA: EOD Tue.
leo: I'll run a perf estimate for avg_seq=80 at 3M tokens/day — rough ballpark: 12-18 GPU hours/day on A100-equivalent, depending on batching. Will post numbers once sim completes.
maya: Great — marking this as an account expansion signal and renewal risk/opportunity. Will follow up with meeting notes after Wed. :tada:
sam: tagging follow-ups — @eng-runtime @sales
